sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: This app collects the following information: Name, Email, Phone Number, and a message. This information is used to contact you to discuss the project. It is not used for any other purpose.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: Contact information you provide (name, email, phone number, and message) is used solely to respond to your inquiry. It is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: XO Fun uses Google AdMob to display advertisements. AdMob may collect device identifiers and usage data to serve ads. Child-directed treatment is enabled under COPPA, which instructs Google to serve only non-personalized ads. For details, see Google's privacy policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: Contact information submitted through the app is retained only as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry and is then deleted.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: XO Fun is designed for general audiences including children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. The app is configured to comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). For information on how Google handles data in child-directed contexts, please review Google's privacy policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We do not collect any personal information. The App does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide any personal details to play.

sections.heading: Data Stored on Your Device
sections.body: The App keeps track of your game statistics (such as wins, losses, and games played) so you can see your progress over time. This information is stored locally on your device using Apple's standard local storage (UserDefaults) and never leaves your device. It is not synced to iCloud, sent to any server, or shared with any third party. You can clear this data at any time by resetting your statistics within the App or by deleting the App from your device.

sections.heading: Advertising
sections.body: The App uses Google AdMob to display banner advertisements. Ads are requested as non-personalized only — the App does not show the App Tracking Transparency permission prompt and does not allow AdMob to track you across other companies' apps or websites. To serve ads, measure their performance, and protect against fraud, Google's Mobile Ads SDK may collect: a device identifier (used for ads, frequency capping, and fraud prevention); approximate (coarse) location, estimated from IP address; advertising interaction data (such as ads shown or clicked); and crash and performance diagnostics. This data is not linked to your identity and is not used to track you across other apps or websites. It is handled according to Google's Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) and How Google uses information from partner sites or apps (https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: The App integrates with Google AdMob to display advertising, as described above. It does not integrate with any other third-party services, analytics providers, or advertising networks.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: The App does not knowingly collect any personal information from anyone, including children under the age of 13. Advertising shown in the App is limited to non-personalized ads.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: If this Privacy Policy is updated, the revised version will be posted at this same location with an updated effective date.

sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at itsnateguy@gmail.com.
